message.content:
The sequence follows the Fibonacci-type rule: each term is the sum of the two previous terms.

\(3+3=6\)  
\(3+6=9\)  
\(6+9=15\)  
\(9+15=24\)  
\(15+24=39\)  
\(24+39=63\)

So the next term is:

\(39+63=102\)

<answer>102</answer>
